en: Old black‑and‑white photograph of a Gothic‑revival Catholic church altar. The central panel shows a crucifixion scene with Christ on the cross, flanked by two niches containing standing statues of saints. The altar rail in front is decorated with pointed arches, and the reredos rises in tall pinnacles and tracery, topped by a cross. The photo has white borders with scalloped edges, typical of mid‑20th‑century postcard prints. No text is visible on the image side.
